_comment: Alert routing. Copy to configs/routing.json to activate. FIRST MATCHING RULE WINS, so put specific rules above general ones; anything unmatched falls back to `default`, so an alert can never be silently dropped. Channels: console | webhook:<url> | telegram:<token>:<chat_id> | whatsapp (Twilio creds from env) — comma-separate to fan out.

rules._comment: Life-safety first: fire, weapons and violence page the guard immediately, and escalate to a second channel if nobody acknowledges within 5 minutes.
rules.name: critical-to-guard

rules._comment: One camera, one owner — the stockroom manager gets stockroom alerts.
rules.name: stockroom-owner

rules._comment: Out of hours nobody is on the shop floor, so anything at all goes to the on-call phone.
rules.name: night-shift

rules._comment: Loitering is worth logging but should not wake anyone.
rules.name: loitering-log-only
